text: Any doctor would tell you the same. Strychnine is, in a certain sense, a cumulative poison, but it would be quite impossible for it to result in sudden death in this way. There would have to be a long period of chronic symptoms which would at once have attracted my attention. The whole thing is absurd.” “And the second suggestion? That Mrs. Inglethorp may have inadvertently taken an overdose?” “Three, or even four doses, would not have resulted in death.
